capacity:api.title: api can't keep up
capacity:api.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 16/s and handles 16/s (100%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:api.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

single-point:api.title: Every request goes through one api
single-point:api.message: It runs 1 replica at 100% of what it can handle, and every request from Web goes through it: if it stops or slows, Web gets nothing.
single-point:api.rationale: Redundancy is what turns one instance's availability into a service's: with two replicas, one can stop (a deploy, a crash, a node drained) while the other answers.
